ULID Generator

Generate real ULIDs: 48-bit millisecond timestamp plus 80-bit crypto randomness in Crockford base32.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose how many ULIDs to generate (1–500).
  2. Click Generate ULIDs.
  3. Copy them or download as a text file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is a ULID built?

The first 10 chars encode the millisecond timestamp; the last 16 are 80 bits from crypto.getRandomValues.

Which alphabet is used?

Crockford base32 (0-9, A-Z minus I, L, O, U) — 26 characters, URL-safe and case-insensitive.

Can I generate many at once?

Yes — batch-generate up to 500 at once, then copy or download them.

Is the randomness secure?

It uses the WebCrypto API, which is cryptographically secure.
